primary.usage: All body text, headings, titles, descriptions, card text, hero text, subtitles, FAQ content — everything read at length. Set at the page/content container level (not body). All content children inherit it.

mono.usage: Applied explicitly to UI system elements only: page indices (/001), page tags, navigation links, buttons, section labels, card IDs, step indices, step titles, metadata, CTAs, form inputs. Creates typographic contrast against Diatype's editorial voice.

contextRule.appShell: The global body element sets font-family: IBM Plex Mono. This governs the home page shell, nav bar, and any element that doesn't explicitly override it.
contextRule.contentPages: Sector pages set font-family: Diatype on their root .page container. This flips the base to Diatype for all content. IBM Plex Mono is then re-applied explicitly to accent/system elements within that context.
contextRule.mentalModel: IBM Plex Mono = system/machine voice (navigation, codes, IDs, buttons, labels). Diatype = human/editorial voice (body text, headings, prose). The shell speaks in system voice. Content experiences speak in human voice.

heroDisplayShell.usage: Home page hero display title only.

heroDisplaySector.usage: Sector page hero title. white-space: pre-line for multi-line breaks.

bodyText.usage: Hero subtitles, section descriptions, card body text, FAQ answers, list descriptions.

cardTitle.usage: Card titles in content grids. Note: lowercase, not uppercase — intentional.

faqQuestion.usage: FAQ accordion question text. Also lowercase.

monoTag.usage: Page tags (DEFENSE AI INTEGRATION etc.). Always Mono.

monoSectionLabel.usage: Section meta labels (Consulting, Why us, Services...). Always Mono.

monoStepLabel.usage: Methodology step indices and titles. Always Mono.

monoButton.usage: All buttons (primary CTA, CTA band button, nav chips). Always Mono.

monoNavUI.usage: Navigation links, explore label, shell nav elements. Always Mono.

monoFormInput.usage: Contact form inputs and field labels.

conventions.diatypeCase: Normal/sentence case or all-lowercase. Diatype elements are NEVER uppercase (with the exception of all-caps hero titles on the home page).
conventions.monoCase: Always uppercase. Every IBM Plex Mono element uses text-transform: uppercase — no exceptions.
conventions.cardBodyIndent: text-indent: 30px on card body paragraphs — a deliberate typographic detail to preserve.
conventions.sectorPageSetup: Set font-family: $font-primary on the .page root. Then apply $font-mono explicitly to each accent/system element.
